We affirm the portion of the district court’s judgment holding (1) that the GHA must make a finding of good cause before approving the termination of a tenancy, (2) that a tenant in this program has a constitutionally protected expectation of remaining in his home in the absence of good cause for eviction, and (3) that the eviction constitutes state action.
Accordingly, we must vacate the sentences and remand for resentencing.

Consequently, we AFFIRM in part, REVERSE in part, and REMAND with instruction to enter judgment in favor of Compass for $224,908 and to address pre- and post-judgment interest and any other ancillary matters, all in accordance with this opinion. .
